verses.greek: Τί οὖν ἐροῦμεν; ἐπιμένωμεν τῇ ἁμαρτίᾳ, ἵνα ἡ χάρις πλεονάσῃ;
verses.literal: What then will we say? Shall we continue the in sin that the grace may abound?
verses.dgt: What then shall we say? Shall we continue in sin so that grace may increase?

verses.greek: μὴ γένοιτο· οἵτινες ἀπεθάνομεν τῇ ἁμαρτίᾳ, πῶς ἔτι ζήσομεν ἐν αὐτῇ;
verses.literal: Never would it be! Who we died the to sin how still will we live in it?
verses.dgt: Certainly not! We who died to sin, how will we still live in it?

verses.greek: ἢ ἀγνοεῖτε ὅτι ὅσοι ἐβαπτίσθημεν εἰς Χριστὸν Ἰησοῦν εἰς τὸν θάνατον αὐτοῦ ἐβαπτίσθημεν;
verses.literal: Or are you unaware that as many as were baptized into Christ Jesus into the death of Him were baptized?
verses.dgt: Or do you not know that as many of us as were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?

verses.greek: συνετάφημεν οὖν αὐτῷ διὰ τοῦ βαπτίσματος εἰς τὸν θάνατον, ἵνα ὥσπερ ἠγέρθη Χριστὸς ἐκ νεκρῶν διὰ τῆς δόξης τοῦ πατρός, οὕτως καὶ ἡμεῖς ἐν καινότητι ζωῆς περιπατήσωμεν.
verses.literal: We were buried therefore with Him through the baptism into the death so that just as was raised up Christ out from the dead through the glory of the Father so also we ourselves in newness of life may walk.
verses.dgt: Therefore we were buried with him through baptism into death, so that just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, so we also might walk in newness of life.

verses.greek: Εἰ γὰρ σύμφυτοι γεγόναμεν τῷ ὁμοιώματι τοῦ θανάτου αὐτοῦ, ἀλλὰ καὶ τῆς ἀναστάσεως ἐσόμεθα·
verses.literal: If for united we have become in the likeness of the death of Him certainly also of the resurrection we will be
verses.dgt: For if we have become united with the likeness of his death, we will certainly also be united with his resurrection.

verses.greek: τοῦτο γινώσκοντες ὅτι ὁ παλαιὸς ἡμῶν ἄνθρωπος συνεσταυρώθη, ἵνα καταργηθῇ τὸ σῶμα τῆς ἁμαρτίας, τοῦ μηκέτι δουλεύειν ἡμᾶς τῇ ἁμαρτίᾳ,
verses.literal: this knowing that the old of us self was crucified with Him so that may be annulled the body the of sin that no longer being enslaved we the to sin.
verses.dgt: Knowing this, that our old person was crucified with him so that the body of sin might be rendered powerless, so that we would no longer serve sin,

verses.greek: ὁ γὰρ ἀποθανὼν δεδικαίωται ἀπὸ τῆς ἁμαρτίας.
verses.literal: The one for having died he has been freed from the sin.
verses.dgt: for the one who died has been justified from sin.

verses.greek: εἰ δὲ ἀπεθάνομεν σὺν Χριστῷ, πιστεύομεν ὅτι καὶ συζήσομεν αὐτῷ·
verses.literal: If now we died with Christ we believe that also we will live with Him
verses.dgt: But if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with him,

verses.greek: εἰδότες ὅτι Χριστὸς ἐγερθεὶς ἐκ νεκρῶν οὐκέτι ἀποθνῄσκει, θάνατος αὐτοῦ οὐκέτι κυριεύει·
verses.literal: knowing that Christ having been raised up out from the dead no longer dies Death over Him no longer rules.
verses.dgt: knowing that Christ, having been raised from the dead, no longer dies; death no longer rules over him.

verses.greek: ὃ γὰρ ἀπέθανεν, τῇ ἁμαρτίᾳ ἀπέθανεν ἐφάπαξ· ὃ δὲ ζῇ, ζῇ τῷ θεῷ.
verses.literal: That which for He died the to sin He died once for all that which however He lives He lives the to God.
verses.dgt: For the death he died, he died to sin once for all; but the life he lives, he lives to God.

verses.greek: οὕτως καὶ ὑμεῖς λογίζεσθε ἑαυτοὺς εἶναι νεκροὺς μὲν τῇ ἁμαρτίᾳ ζῶντας δὲ τῷ θεῷ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ.
verses.literal: So also you yourselves do consider yourselves to be dead indeed the to sin living however the to God in Christ Jesus
verses.dgt: So also you, consider yourselves dead to sin but living to God in Christ Jesus.

verses.greek: Μὴ οὖν βασιλευέτω ἡ ἁμαρτία ἐν τῷ θνητῷ ὑμῶν σώματι εἰς τὸ ὑπακούειν ταῖς ἐπιθυμίαις αὐτοῦ,
verses.literal: Not therefore should reign the sin in the mortal of you body in order the to obey the desires of it
verses.dgt: Therefore do not let sin reign in your mortal body so that you obey its desires,

verses.greek: μηδὲ παριστάνετε τὰ μέλη ὑμῶν ὅπλα ἀδικίας τῇ ἁμαρτίᾳ, ἀλλὰ παραστήσατε ἑαυτοὺς τῷ θεῷ ὡσεὶ ἐκ νεκρῶν ζῶντας καὶ τὰ μέλη ὑμῶν ὅπλα δικαιοσύνης τῷ θεῷ.
verses.literal: Neither do yield the members of you as instruments of unrighteousness the to sin but do yield yourselves the to God as out from the dead living and the members of you as instruments of righteousness the to God.
verses.dgt: nor present your members to sin as weapons of unrighteousness, but present yourselves to God as alive from the dead, and your members to God as weapons of righteousness.

verses.greek: ἁμαρτία γὰρ ὑμῶν οὐ κυριεύσει, οὐ γάρ ἐστε ὑπὸ νόμον ἀλλὰ ὑπὸ χάριν.
verses.literal: Sin for you not will rule over not for you are under law but under grace.
verses.dgt: For sin will not rule over you, for you are not under law but under grace.

verses.greek: Τί οὖν; ἁμαρτήσωμεν ὅτι οὐκ ἐσμὲν ὑπὸ νόμον ἀλλὰ ὑπὸ χάριν; μὴ γένοιτο·
verses.literal: What then? Shall we sin because not we are under law but under grace? Never would it be!
verses.dgt: What then? Shall we sin because we are not under law but under grace? Certainly not!

verses.greek: οὐκ οἴδατε ὅτι ᾧ παριστάνετε ἑαυτοὺς δούλους εἰς ὑπακοήν, δοῦλοί ἐστε ᾧ ὑπακούετε, ἤτοι ἁμαρτίας εἰς θάνατον ἢ ὑπακοῆς εἰς δικαιοσύνην;
verses.literal: Not know you that to whom you yield yourselves as slaves for obedience slaves you are to him whom you obey whether of sin to death or of obedience to righteousness?
verses.dgt: Do you not know that to whomever you present yourselves as slaves for obedience, you are slaves of the one whom you obey, either of sin leading to death or of obedience leading to righteousness?

verses.greek: χάρις δὲ τῷ θεῷ ὅτι ἦτε δοῦλοι τῆς ἁμαρτίας ὑπηκούσατε δὲ ἐκ καρδίας εἰς ὃν παρεδόθητε τύπον διδαχῆς,
verses.literal: Thanks be however the to God that you were slaves the of sin you have become obedient now from the heart to which you were handed over to the form of teaching.
verses.dgt: But thanks be to God that though you were slaves of sin, you obeyed from the heart the pattern of teaching to which you were handed over,

verses.greek: ἐλευθερωθέντες δὲ ἀπὸ τῆς ἁμαρτίας ἐδουλώθητε τῇ δικαιοσύνῃ·
verses.literal: Having been set free now from the sin you have become slaves the to righteousness.
verses.dgt: and having been set free from sin, you became enslaved to righteousness.

verses.greek: ἀνθρώπινον λέγω διὰ τὴν ἀσθένειαν τῆς σαρκὸς ὑμῶν· ὥσπερ γὰρ παρεστήσατε τὰ μέλη ὑμῶν δοῦλα τῇ ἀκαθαρσίᾳ καὶ τῇ ἀνομίᾳ εἰς τὴν ἀνομίαν, οὕτως νῦν παραστήσατε τὰ μέλη ὑμῶν δοῦλα τῇ δικαιοσύνῃ εἰς ἁγιασμόν.
verses.literal: In human terms I speak on account of the weakness of the flesh of you. For as for you yielded the members of you as slaves the to impurity and the to lawlessness unto the lawlessness so now do yield the members of you as slaves the to righteousness unto sanctification.
verses.dgt: I am speaking in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh. For just as you presented your members as slaves to impurity and to lawlessness leading to lawlessness, so now present your members as slaves to righteousness leading to sanctification.

verses.greek: Ὅτε γὰρ δοῦλοι ἦτε τῆς ἁμαρτίας, ἐλεύθεροι ἦτε τῇ δικαιοσύνῃ.
verses.literal: When for slaves you were the of sin free you were the from righteousness.
verses.dgt: For when you were slaves of sin, you were free with respect to righteousness.

verses.greek: τίνα οὖν καρπὸν εἴχετε τότε ἐφʼ οἷς νῦν ἐπαισχύνεσθε; τὸ γὰρ τέλος ἐκείνων θάνατος·
verses.literal: What therefore fruit had you then in the things of which now you are ashamed? The for end of those things is death.
verses.dgt: Therefore what fruit did you have then from the things of which you are now ashamed? For the end of those things is death.

verses.greek: νυνὶ δέ, ἐλευθερωθέντες ἀπὸ τῆς ἁμαρτίας δουλωθέντες δὲ τῷ θεῷ, ἔχετε τὸν καρπὸν ὑμῶν εἰς ἁγιασμόν, τὸ δὲ τέλος ζωὴν αἰώνιον.
verses.literal: Now however having been set free from the sin having become slaves now the to God you have the fruit of you unto sanctification the now the end is life eternal.
verses.dgt: But now, having been set free from sin and enslaved to God, you have your fruit leading to sanctification, and the end, eternal life.

verses.greek: τὰ γὰρ ὀψώνια τῆς ἁμαρτίας θάνατος, τὸ δὲ χάρισμα τοῦ θεοῦ ζωὴ αἰώνιος ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ τῷ κυρίῳ ἡμῶν.
verses.literal: The for wages the of sin is death the but the gift the of God life eternal in Christ Jesus the Lord of us.
verses.dgt: For the wages of sin is death, but the gracious gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
